title: Elizondo points AARO to a safe drawer that turns out empty

tellings.quote: but I know there was an episode uh like this with Lou Alzando where he told them of a particular location, an office, a safe a safe drawer, and the uh only to be told that when uh when they opened it up, there was nothing there.

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, once told investigators from the Pentagon's current office for unexplained aerial reports exactly where to look: a particular office, a particular safe, a particular safe drawer. When they opened it, according to the story, there was nothing there. Kurt McConnell, a Senate staffer, passes this on as an episode he heard about, not one he saw, and it matters because a full drawer would have been hard evidence of hidden material.
